title: Installments Counted for a Plan Whose Installment Has Been Reset
content:
Patient Services Academy — training note on **Patient Payment Plans**: the installments counted for a plan whose regular installment no longer matches the installment set at acceptance.

## The rule

The installments counted for a plan depend on whether its installment has been reset: on a plan whose standing installment differs from the installment set at acceptance (the enrolled balances less the acceptance down payment, divided by the term's installments and rounded to the cent) and whose installments are drawn automatically, they are the carried balance divided by the standing installment, to the nearest whole installment; on such a plan whose installments are not drawn automatically, that quotient rounded up to a whole installment; on any other plan, the installments still to fall due under the term.

## Terms

- **Installment set at acceptance** — every enrollment line on the plan ledger added together, less the down payment fixed at acceptance, divided by the number of installments of the term and rounded to the cent.
- **Standing installment** — the regular monthly installment on the plan record now.
- **Carried balance** — the invoice balances enrolled on the plan, less the down payment fixed at acceptance, less every scheduled-installment, arrears, extra-principal and payoff payment, less every release on the plan ledger.
- **Nearest whole installment** — a fractional part of one half or more rounds up, below one half rounds down.
- **Drawn automatically** — the plan's automatic-payment setting, whatever the method.

## Decision table

| Standing installment differs from the installment set at acceptance | Drawn automatically | Installments counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Carried balance divided by the standing installment, to the nearest whole installment |
| Yes | No | The same quotient, rounded up to a whole installment |
| No | Yes or No | The installments still to fall due under the term |

## Questions answered (hypothetical plans)

**A 12-month plan with enrollment lines of 1,440.00 and no acceptance down payment had an installment of 120.00 at acceptance; after an assistance release it now stands at 95.00, with automatic payments. The carried balance is 760.00. How many installments are counted?** The installment differs from 120.00. 760.00 divided by 95.00 is 8 exactly: 8.

**The same plan with a carried balance of 790.00?** 790.00 divided by 95.00 is 8.32: to the nearest whole installment, 8. Paid manually instead, the quotient is rounded up: 9.

**A plan whose standing installment still equals the installment set at acceptance?** The installments still to fall due under the term are counted.
